objects.query: SELECT BasedOnId, CanRamp, ConfigureDuringSale, Description, DisplayUrl, Family, IsActive, IsAssetizable, IsSoldOnlyWithOtherProds, Name, ProductCode, QuantityUnitOfMeasure, SpecificationType, StockKeepingUnit, Type, UnitOfMeasureId FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'HVAC-COM-%' ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT DoesAutoRenewAssetByDefault, Name, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, SellingModelType, Status FROM ProductSellingModel ORDER BY Name ASC, SellingModelType ASC

SELECT IsDefault, Product2Id, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModelId, ProductSellingModel.Name, ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType, ProrationPolicyId FROM ProductSellingModelOption WHERE Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE 'HVAC-COM-%' ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT CatalogType, Code, Description, EffectiveEndDate, EffectiveStartDate, Name FROM ProductCatalog WHERE Code = 'CAT-HVAC-COM' ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT CatalogId, Code, Description, IsNavigational, Name, ParentCategoryId, SortOrder FROM ProductCategory WHERE Code LIKE 'PC-HVAC-COM-%' ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT IsPrimaryCategory, ProductId, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ProductCategoryId, ProductCategory.Code FROM ProductCategoryProduct WHERE ProductCategory.Code LIKE 'PC-HVAC-COM-%' ORDER BY ProductCategory.Code ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC
